content: उपक्रमः .²1 Beginning, commencement; रामोपक्रममाचख्यौ रक्षःपरिभवं नवम् <ls>R. 12. 42</ls> begun by Rāma; किमुपक्रमो रावणः <ls>Mv. 2</ls>. .²2 Approach, advance; साहस˚ forcible advance <ls>Māl. 7</ls>; so योषितः सुकुमारोपक्रमाः {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%} .²3 An undertaking, work, enterprize. .²4 A plan, contrivance, means, expedient, stratagem, remedy; सामादिभिरुपक्रमैः <ls>Ms. 7. 107</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 7.">159</ls>; <ls>M. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 18. 15</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 345</ls>; <ls>Śi. 20. 76</ls>. .²5 Attendance on a patient, treatment, practice of medicine, physicking. .²6 A test of honesty, trying the fidelity of a friend <ab>&c.</ab>; see उपधा. .²7 A kind of ceremony preparatory to reading the Vedas. .²8 Heroism, Courage. .²9 Flight. .²10 Behaviour, action; यद्यप्यकृतकृत्यानामीदृशः स्यादुपक्रमः <ls>Rām. 5. 64. 30</ls>. .²11 The rim of a wheel; <ls>Hch.</ls>
